data.user_prompt: What are the top AI development companies in Dubai for enterprise projects?

sections.text:
For enterprise AI projects in Dubai, the strongest shortlist is **G42/Core42, Presight, IBM, Microsoft, Accenture, Injazat, and specialized delivery firms such as Simform, SoluLab, Lumitech, and Code Brew Labs**. The best choice depends on whether the project requires sovereign-scale infrastructure, enterprise consulting, or hands-on application development.

## Recommended shortlist

| Company | Best suited for | Why consider it |
|---|---|---|
| **G42 / Core42** | Large government, healthcare, data-intensive, and sovereign-AI programs | Strong regional AI infrastructure, cloud, data, and large-scale deployment capabilities. G42 is generally headquartered in Abu Dhabi rather than Dubai, but operates across the UAE and is highly relevant for national-scale enterprise work.[1][3] |
| **Presight** | Smart-city analytics, public-sector intelligence, geospatial data, and operational analytics | Focuses on big-data analytics and applied AI for government and large organizations.[7] |
| **IBM Middle East** | Regulated enterprises, hybrid cloud, AI governance, and legacy-system integration | A strong fit for banks, utilities, healthcare organizations, and government departments that need explainable AI, governance, and integration with existing IT estates.[4][10] |
| **Microsoft Gulf** | Azure-based AI, generative AI, Copilot, MLOps, and secure enterprise data platforms | Suitable for organizations already using Microsoft technologies and needing cloud-native AI with enterprise security and compliance capabilities.[4][10] |
| **Accenture** | Enterprise-wide AI transformation and strategy-to-production programs | Best for large organizations that need operating-model redesign, data modernization, process transformation, and AI implementation at scale.[4][10] |
| **Injazat** | UAE government, regulated sectors, managed cloud, and local data operations | Offers strong UAE market knowledge and experience with secure cloud, cybersecurity, and large public-sector environments.[3][4] |
| **Simform** | AI embedded into complex software products and enterprise platforms | Combines AI engineering with cloud, data, product engineering, and enterprise software delivery.[2][7] |
| **SoluLab** | Generative AI, AI agents, customer automation, blockchain, and IoT | A suitable specialist partner for customer-facing AI applications and integrated digital products.[1][7] |
| **Lumitech** | RAG, agentic AI, ML platforms, and end-to-end implementation | Positioned as a Dubai-based delivery partner covering AI strategy, development, integration, and production deployment.[7] |
| **Code Brew Labs** | Custom LLM applications, chatbots, computer vision, NLP, MLOps, and enterprise software | Dubai-headquartered engineering firm with a broad custom-AI and software-development offering.[6] |
| **Derq** | Transport, road safety, computer vision, and mobility analytics | Particularly relevant for smart-mobility, traffic, fleet, and road-infrastructure use cases.[4] |

## Practical selection guidance

- Choose **G42/Core42, Presight, or Injazat** for sovereign cloud, government, healthcare infrastructure, or very large data platforms.
- Choose **IBM, Microsoft, or Accenture** when AI must integrate with a complex enterprise estate and requires governance, security, and organizational transformation.
- Choose **Simform, SoluLab, Lumitech, or Code Brew Labs** when the priority is building and deploying a specific AI product, agent, data platform, or workflow automation system.
- Choose **Derq** for transport and road-safety applications rather than general-purpose enterprise AI.

Before selecting a vendor, require evidence of comparable production deployments, data-residency and UAE compliance capabilities, model-governance practices, integration experience, post-launch support, and a clear transition from proof of concept to production. Industry rankings are useful for creating a shortlist, but they should not replace reference checks and a technical proof of value.[1][2][7]
